A violent '''civil conflict''' erupted on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> pitting members of the native [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Species/Legends|species]] against other Duros and forcing the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to intervene in order to end the [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]]. Among the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent to Duro was the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Tol Braga]] on his first assignment as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and the violence Braga witnessed on the planet convinced the Kel Dor to become a determined pacifist.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The conflict on Duro is mentioned only in the Codex entry for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Tol Braga, a character featured in Act II of the Jedi Knight storyline in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released in late [[2011]]. The exact date and outcome of the conflict is never specified.<ref name="Codex" />
